title: A zone's camera areas: res/field/cameras/areas/<zone>.json or rail_areas/<rails>.json
description: The parts of the map where the camera changes as the player walks in (CameraArea, include/field/field_scene_area.h; archives a/1/5/6 for zones on a grid, which ZONE_CAMERA_ASSIGNMENTS in src/system/zonedata.c gives their file, and a/0/7/9 for rail maps, which res/field/rails/maps.json's camera_areas numbers). The last area the player is in wins. Angles are in 65536ths of a turn; positions and distances fx32, 4096 a unit, 16 units a tile. tools/data/camera_data.py packs them.

zones.description: A grid file's zones, which have these areas (ZONE_CAMERA_ASSIGNMENTS; Paper White 2's build reads them from here, so a new zone can be added). Rail files leave it out: res/field/rails/maps.json numbers them

areas.description: The areas, in the order the game checks them

check.description: rect: a rectangle of tiles (grid zones only); circle: a ring around a point, between two radii and two angles

stay.description: What the camera does while the player is in it, CAM_CALC_FUNCS's number: 0 aims from the circle's center, 1 looks from a fixed position at a fixed target, 2 blends pitch, yaw and distance across the rect, 3 and 4 the same turning the delay off or on, 5 to 7 as 2 to 4 also blending the target offset and the field of view

enter.description: What it does as the player enters, the same numbers

exit.description: What it does as the player leaves, the same numbers

rect.description: The rectangle and its two camera settings, which the camera blends between from its first row to its last (along x where width is 1: then height is its width in x and unk06 its depth)

height.description: Its depth in tiles, along which the camera blends

pitch.description: The camera's pitch at the first row and the last

yaw.description: Its yaw at the first row and the last

distance.description: Its distance from the target, fx32

forbid_delay.description: Whether the stay functions 3, 4, 6 and 7 turn the camera's delay off and on

target_offset.description: What it looks at, from the player, at the first row and the last

fov.description: Half its field of view, in 65536ths of a turn

angle.description: The angles it runs between, around its center

radius.description: The radii it runs between, fx32

distance.description: Its distance from the center, in units

target.description: The fixed target of stay function 1

position.description: The fixed position of stay function 1

unk3c.description: 0 in every file, left out when 0

defaults.title: The default cameras: res/field/cameras/defaults.json
defaults.description: The cameras that a zone's camera numbers (FieldCameraDefaults, a/0/5/9): the camera follows the player (bind) at target from them, or looks at target

zoom.description: Its distance from the target, in units

swap_mode.description: The 3D buffer's mode, Z or W

target.description: What it looks at, from the player with bind
